Hi Elena —

Thanks — super helpful framing. Drafted two clear options and attached a simple model so you can plug-in Zephyr's usage numbers (pricing_model_zephyr.xlsx). High level:

Option A — Immediate annualize (single change now)
- Bill the incremental 30% prorated over the remaining 6 months, then annualize to co-term at Dec 31.
- One-time proration charge on next invoice + new annualized rate.
- Discount: we can offer a 7% uplift discount at this band if Zephyr commits to the annualized quantity.
- Pros: operationally simple; one PO. Cons: larger immediate invoice impact.

Option B — Staged top-up (recommended by customer finance)
- Split the 30% uplift into three quarterly increments (Jul, Sep, Nov). Each increment is invoiced at time of activation, with a modest step discount.
- Offer a 5% step discount across the staged uplift and a 3% voucher credit applied at renewal if all top-ups are executed.
- Pros: smoother cash flow; aligns to product rollout. Cons: more invoices / PO management.

SLA: no exception required — capacity is available in our Dedicated pool; we'll reserve a buffer for the staged path but we do recommend a short canary period for each activation (usually 48–72 hrs).

I've attached: zephyr_proposal_v1.pdf (narrative + T&Cs) and pricing_model_zephyr.xlsx (workbook). Can we set a 30-min sync Monday to confirm P&L impact for procurement?

Best,
Ben
